sql_templates.description: Fetch current portfolio holdings along with latest stage and technical scores to identify add or trim opportunities.
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_snapshots AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
)
SELECT p.symbol, p.qty, p.avg_cost, s.company_name, s.sector, s.price, s.change_1d_pct,
       s.trading_signal, s.stage, s.stage_score
FROM portfolio.holdings p
JOIN latest_snapshots s ON p.symbol = s.symbol
WHERE s.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
ORDER BY s.change_1d_pct DESC
LIMIT 10;
